title: Mussels in a Velvety Sour Croatian Broth
description: A hearty seafood dish featuring mussels in a rich and tangy broth, inspired by Croatian culinary traditions.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Croatian white wine and cook for 2-3 minutes, until reduced by half.
Add the mussels, velvety sour cream, and chopped parsley. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the mussels are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the mussels in the rich broth, with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
